page_topic_one_liner: CAD and AI CAD — parametric B-Rep solids, text-to-CAD APIs, and Copilot-in-CAD for manufacturable engineering geometry
differentiator_vs_generic: This is engineering CAD (STEP, feature trees, tolerances), NOT DCC mesh sculpting, NOT text-to-3D showcase mesh generators, NOT interior design renders. Hero must be a parametric CAD viewport with wireframe B-Rep solid, feature tree, and text-to-CAD prompt bar.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Parametric CAD viewport — isometric wireframe B-Rep bracket solid with dimension lines, klein-blue accent on selected edge
Feature tree panel: vertical stack of 4-5 feature nodes (Extrude, Fillet, Hole blur labels) with expand chevrons
Secondary: text-to-CAD prompt bar at top with natural-language blur input and arrow into geometry
anti_patterns: Polygon mesh sculpt (Blender/ZBrush style) as hero
LLM chat panel unrelated to geometry
